name: Romantic Epoch
detail: MMS provisional epoch associated with Transcendentalism, photography, and Romantic art.

name: Commune Epoch
detail: MMS provisional epoch associated with the Paris Commune and revolutionary art.

name: Tesla Epoch
detail: MMS epoch associated with Wardenclyffe and technological and creative innovation.

name: WWI trough
detail: MMS approximate trough year associated with the Somme and Verdun.

name: Surrealist Epoch
detail: The Persistence of Memory is the defining artwork in the MMS. Only its year is recorded here; no painting day or month is asserted.

name: Postwar trough
detail: MMS approximate trough year reflecting the preceding war and its aftermath; individual events retain their own dates.

name: Beat Epoch
detail: MMS epoch associated with Beat culture, music, civil rights, and the Space Race. This marker does not assign a formation date to the Beatles.

name: Tradition / Renewal
detail: MMS approximate trough year, with punk described as a renewal signal.

name: Grunge Epoch
detail: MMS epoch associated with Nevermind, the early internet, and cultural and political change.

name: Tradition trough
detail: MMS approximate trough year associated with surveillance, war, and institutional contraction.

name: Trans / Hyperpop Epoch
detail: MMS epoch associated with trans visibility, hyperpop, and distributed creative tools.
